card.name: Inside kinase inhibitor drug names
card.fires_on: The piece of a longer word just before its ending, most often the 'ib' in names like ruxolitinib or ripretinib. It also appears partway through other split words such as buffaloes or alkaloids.

modes.label: -tinib drug names

modes.example: increase ripretin<<ib>> dose frequency to twice daily.
